item.title: Christian Author Philip Yancey Admits Eight-Year Affair, Steps Away From Ministry
item.description: "To my great shame, I confess that for eight years I willfully engaged in a sinful affair with a married woman."

item.title: Minnesota Police Who Refused To Work With ICE Now Mad Feds Won’t Work With Them
item.description: Minnesota’s criminal investigations agency said Thursday that the U.S. attorney’s office barred it from participating in the probe into the fatal shooting of Minneapolis resident Renee Nicole Good during a U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) operation.

item.title: Trump’s Unveiled Ballroom Plans Reveal Bigger, Taller White House Addition
item.description: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump’s ambitious vision for an East Wing modernization and state ballroom addition to the White House underwent its first test of public scrutiny Thursday, as designers presented the project before the National Capital Planning Commission (NCPC) for approval to start construction as early as April.

item.title: FBI Probes Federal Agent Shooting That Left Two Injured in Portland
item.description: Authorities have released a few details so far, citing the early and active nature of the probe.

item.title: Feds Shoot Two In Portland
item.description: Police in Portland, Ore. said federal agents shot two people Thursday afternoon, prompting an FBI investigation.

item.title: Minneapolis Teachers Union President Says District Will Offer Virtual Learning For Next Five Weeks
item.description: The president of the Minneapolis Federation of Teachers said Thursday that Minneapolis Public Schools will allow students to shift to virtual learning through Feb. 12.

item.title: Cameraman Catches Moment Grenade Hits Congresswoman, Explodes On Head
item.description: National Party Deputy Gladis Aurora Lopez Calderon of the Honduran Congress was seriously wounded when a grenade detonated near her head at the National Congress Thursday, multiple outlets reported.
